_why: DEF-ROC-211. `.claude/tools/isolated-commit.js` is the tool every agent's every commit passes through, its 78-case suite encodes the founding four-agent silent LOSS + DEFECT-OAG-142's silent DUPLICATION + DEF-ROC-189's continuity limb, and `grep -rn "claude/tools" .github/workflows/` returned NOTHING -- the whole `.claude/tools/` tree ran only when a human or agent happened to type `node --test`. This is the PARENT-REPO half of the `guard-coverage.json` class (work/ROC/scripts/guard-coverage.json, DEF-ROC-165): that ledger's own `_not_covered_here` field records it cannot see past the project/parent lane boundary (v50 gives each project its own nested, gitignored repo), so a ledger living in a PROJECT repo can never be the thing that declares a PARENT-repo tool's coverage -- it would need one redundant copy per project and would still not run in the parent's own CI. This file is that missing parent-repo ledger, and `tool-coverage.js` is its checker: it verifies every `.claude/tools/*.test.js` is DECLARED below (an undeclared file is exactly how the class recurs -- DEF-ROC-165's carrier, DEF-ROC-202's gauge), that the declared `lane` workflow actually invokes `runBy` (a carrier with no caller is not a control), and then RUNS the suite -- tolerating only the pre-declared, environment-dependent failures in `knownEnvironmentGaps` so a NEW failure anywhere else is red, never silently absorbed.
_self_coverage: The ledger must cover its own checker, or an unwired coverage check is the very defect it exists to detect (DEF-ROC-165's `scripts/guardCoverage.mjs` precedent) -- `tool-coverage.js` and `tool-coverage.test.js` are both declared in `guards` below, same as every other tool.
